items.source_en:
Ochim Ka'dic: So when are you going to let me in on some real work?

Mujeen Ka'dic: I would say that kind of work will be unnecessary going forward. The time for armigers is over. An armistice could benefit boths sides.

Ochim Ka'dic: Well, funny you should mention that. I've heard rumblings someone at House Ka'dic was trying to make a truce with the Zealots, by selling them supplies.

Mujeen Ka'dic: Which would be treason if it were true. 

Ochim Ka'dic: Light treason, sure. But still, they're paying real creds for it. That's not going to make them allies. It just makes them customers. And when's the last time you stuck your neck out for the guy who serves you groat? 

Mujeen Ka'dic: Good point. And now you have the gears in my head turning. If we were to GIVE them the supplies...

Ochim Ka'dic: They might just swear their loyalty to you. Damn, that's an incredible idea. 

If you want me to look into it, all you need to do is say the word.

*Static*

Mujeen Ka'dic: But, no. Absolutely not. What you speak of is treason. I will have no part in it.

무진 카딕: 사실이라면 반역죄겠지. 

오킴 카딕: 물론 가벼운 반역죄가 되겠죠. 광신도들이 값을 잘 쳐주긴 하지만 그렇게 해선 그 무리를 동맹으로 만들 순 없어요. 고객이 될 뿐이죠. 그로트 고기 따위를 파는 사람한테 충성을 맹세할 리가 없잖습니까?

무진 카딕: 좋은 지적이군. 그래서 생각난 게, 만약 우리가 물자를 그냥 공짜로 준다면...

오킴 카딕: 그럼 그 무리가 당신에게 충성을 맹세할 수도 있겠죠. 젠장, 완전 좋은 생각인데요. 

말만 하면, 제가 진행해 보겠습니다.

*잠시 정적이 흐른다*

무진 카딕: 그렇지만, 절대 안 돼. 명백한 반역죄야. 난 하지 않겠어.
